proof_roadmap: Sense-making of the statement comes from the continuity of rig-smoothness (lemma-rig-smooth-continuous).
Given rig-smooth B to A and adic B to C, choose an ideal of definition I of B giving the I-adic topology on both A and C.
Apply the base-change lemma for rig-smooth homomorphisms to conclude the completed tensor product A times_C is rig-smooth over (C, IC).
